comparisonMethod: limitPoints are seller-independent plan-level values derived only from first-party plan descriptions. They are the user's simplified cross-service comparison proxy, not a shared physical unit or a guarantee of equal real-world usage. Numeric plan points are normalized within each service to its lowest numerically supported current plan = 1; values are monthly-equivalent for subscription-term calculations. The originalOfficialUnit, originalOfficialQuantity, originalOfficialPeriod, sourceUrl, and rationale preserve the native evidence and its limits. Null means no stable numeric plan allowance can be assigned. Do not label limitPoints as tokens.

minimax.mappingRule: Current M Plan selected tier names Go/Explore/Build map to the separately sourced current global (English) product generation at 1/3/7.5 relative points; they are never aliases for the historical Plus/Max/Ultra tiers. A selected option naming multiple current tiers stays ambiguous. Historical MiniMax Plus/Max/Ultra labels are region-ambiguous. In this catalogue, map a regional legacy plan only when the selected option text explicitly identifies the matching Global/International M Plan/Token Plan or China/CN Token Plan. Seller titles, currency, and generic legacy plan names are insufficient. Without selected-option region evidence, use only a shared normalized score when official regional ratios match (Plus=1 and Max=3); generic Ultra remains null because regional ratios diverge.
